integrity: Analytical proof plus reproducible finite checks; source precedence and originality are self-review rather than independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional diagonal, one fixed-norm probe and one Lanczos node only; normalized sphere is distinct from Gaussian. General matrices, rotations, longer Krylov rules, optimality and earlier priority are not established.
title: A unique conditioning reversal between fixed-norm sign and sphere probes in one-node log-determinant Lanczos quadrature
